description: Defines the 'Rating' class that models user feedback with fields such as id, raterUserId, rateeUserId, score, comment, scheduleItemId, and createdAt. Includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, validation, copying with modifications, and equality checks.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Represents feedback given by one user to another after a session, including score, optional comment, and associated schedule item.

methods.name: isValidScore
methods.description: Checks if the score is within the typical valid range (1..5).

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Rating object with optional modifications.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Rating object to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Rating object from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Converts the Rating object to a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJsonString
methods.description: Creates a Rating object from a JSON string.
